sentences.text:
Mukesh Kumar Saha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 24 April,
2017

Bench: Anant Bijay Singh
In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 1303 of 2017
Mukesh Kumar Saha ..... Petitioner
 Versus
The State of Jharkhand ..... Opp. Party
 ---------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anant Bijay Singh
---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate.
For the State : A.P.P.
 ---------
06/Dated: 24/04/2017
Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Government Case No. 16 of 2015,
corresponding to T.R. No. 2401 of 2016, registered under Section 59 (iii) of the Food Safety and
Standard Act, 2006.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that there is no allegation against the petitioner that any injury or grievous injury has been caused to any person as a result of such consumption and so,
Section 59 (iii) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 is made out against the petitioner.
Learned APP has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Be that as it may, I am inclined to admit the petitioner on anticipatory bail with imposition of cost of Rs. 11,000/- upon the petitioner to be deposited before the President, District Bar Association, Giridih within four weeks.
On deposition of amount by the petitioner, the President will issue receipt to him.
The amount will be utilized only for the welfare of learned Members of Bar Association, Giridih.

The above named petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within two weeks from the date of receiving the receipts of deposition and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the Court below shall enlarge the above named petitioner on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Giridih, in connection with Government Case No. 16 of 2015, corresponding to T.R. No. 2401 of 2016, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C. and further on the date of Mukesh Kumar Saha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 24 April, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126254210/
